description: A React component class 'CRUDCollection' implementing a table with CRUD operations, expandable rows, sorting, and custom rendering, used within the Apache Superset project.

classes.name: CRUDCollection
classes.description: A React component class for managing a collection of items with CRUD operations, expandable rows, sorting, and rendering customization.

methods.name: createKeyedCollection
methods.description: Creates a collection object and array from an array of objects, assigning unique IDs.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Updates internal state when the collection prop changes.

methods.name: onCellChange
methods.description: Handles updates to individual cell values.

methods.name: onAddItem
methods.description: Adds a new item to the collection, optionally expanded.

methods.name: onFieldsetChange
methods.description: Handles changes from the expandable fieldset.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the label for a column, considering custom labels.

methods.name: getTooltip
methods.description: Retrieves tooltip text for a column.

methods.name: changeCollection
methods.description: Updates the collection and maintains item order.

methods.name: deleteItem
methods.description: Removes an item from the collection.

methods.name: handleTableChange
methods.description: Handles sorting and filtering changes in the table.

methods.name: renderExpandableSection
methods.description: Renders the expandable section for a row.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders a cell with optional custom renderer.

methods.name: buildTableColumns
methods.description: Constructs table column definitions, including sorting and delete actions.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the entire CRUD table component with controls and expandable rows.
